quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.emptyBody: A quote for a bakery, a kitchen or a chop bar starts with New quote, or from a request for quote.
quotes.error: The quotes could not be loaded
quotes.denied: You cannot see quotes. Ask an Owner for the quotes permission (quo.quote.read).

quote.error: The quote could not be loaded
quote.noCustomer: Not a customer yet: the contact below

rfqSource.REQUEST_TO_BUY: Request to buy in the shop

creditCheck.notYet: Not checked yet: it is checked when the order is confirmed
creditCheck.PASSED: Within the limit and the terms
creditCheck.OVERRIDDEN: Over the limit or the terms, on an approved override
creditCheck.NOT_REQUIRED: Not needed: not a credit order

acceptanceMethod.SIGNED_LINK: by the link sent to them

quoteRequired.NO_RULE: No price list prices this line for this buyer. Type the agreed price; the server judges the margin.
quoteRequired.QUOTE_ONLY: This product is sold only by quote. Type the agreed price; the server judges the margin.
quoteRequired.MISSING_GRADE_OR_WEIGHT: This line needs a grade or a weight before the API can price it. Type the agreed price.

picker.typeMore: Type two letters or more of the name, phone or customer number

fields.customerHint: A bakery, kitchen, chop bar or shop already on the books. Leave it empty for a new buyer and type their name and phone below.
fields.contactPhoneHint: +233 and nine digits, for example +233557018924. The acceptance link goes to this number.
fields.contactPhoneWrong: Type the phone as +233 and nine digits, for example +233557018924.
fields.validUntilHint: The quote holds until the end of this day, Accra time.
fields.validUntilWrong: Choose today or a later day.
fields.termsHint: For example: 50 percent deposit; prices hold for seven days.
fields.deliveryEstimateHint: Where and when, in words: "Delivered to Kasoa on Friday morning".
fields.taxInclusiveHint: Tick when the prices agreed already include VAT and the levies.
fields.paymentTermsHint: On credit, the order is checked against the buyer's limit and terms when it is confirmed.
fields.creditLimitHint: The most this buyer may owe at once, on invoices and confirmed orders. Raising it past the farm's set amount needs approval.
fields.paymentTermsDaysHint: Days from the invoice to its due date, for example 30.
fields.overdueHoldDaysHint: Days past due after which the account goes on hold by itself. Leave it empty for the farm's default.
fields.daysWrong: Type a whole number of days, from 0 to 365.
fields.priceListHint: The buyer's own prices (a customer price list), read first when their lines are priced.
fields.choosePriceList: No price list of their own

builder.title: New quote
builder.hint: Each line is priced by the API for this buyer. Get the API's prices before saving: the server works out every line total, the tax and the total.
builder.pricesMissing: Some lines have no price yet
builder.pricesMissingBody: Press "Get the API's prices", or type an agreed price for each line the API cannot price.

lines.title: Lines
lines.hint: Crates and single eggs are separate lines, each at its own price: a single egg is never priced from a crate.
lines.unitWaits: Lines by the single egg wait for the server
lines.unitWaitsBody: This build cannot say a line's unit yet (CR-045), so each line is in the product's sale unit.
lines.unitHint: The crate or the single egg. The API prices each by its own entry.
lines.qtyWrong: Type a quantity above nothing, for example 10.
lines.descriptionHint: What the customer reads, for example "Eggs, big, crates of 30".
lines.noApiPrice: The API has no price for this line
lines.agreedPriceHint: The API's price, unless you agreed another. Below the margin floor, the quote waits for approval when it is sent.
lines.priceMissing: Get the API's price, or type the agreed price.

version.title: Version {{number}}
version.olderTitle: An earlier version, as it was
version.olderBody: It is kept as it was sent and cannot be changed. The version in force is at the top of the list.
version.belowFloorBody: Sending this version needs approval by someone other than you.

actions.denied: You do not have the permission for this.
actions.issueBody: The customer gets a link to read and accept it. Earlier versions are replaced and their links stop working.
actions.channelsNone: Choose at least one way to send the link.
actions.reviseBody: A new draft version starts from version {{number}}, which stays as it was. Say what changes.
actions.acceptBody: For an acceptance given in person or by phone. A customer with the link accepts it themselves.
actions.declineBody: Say why, in the customer's words if you can.
actions.convertBody: One order is made, its lines at the quote's prices. Its invoice will carry the order, and the order the quote.
actions.cancelBody: The customer's link stops working. Say why.

outcome.revised: A new draft version of {{name}} was started
outcome.margin: {{name}} is below the margin floor and waits for approval by someone other than you
outcome.marginWaiting: This version waits for margin approval

rfqs.title: Requests for quote
rfqs.emptyBody: Requests from the shop's form, and those logged from calls, appear here.
rfqs.error: The requests could not be loaded
rfqs.denied: You cannot see requests for quote (quo.rfq.read).

rfq.error: The request could not be loaded

done.SPAM: The request is marked as spam

order.error: The order could not be loaded
order.confirmBody: The order's stock is reserved for it.
order.confirmCreditBody: The server checks the buyer's credit limit and terms first. Over either, it refuses, and says by how much.

credit.title: Credit check
credit.error: The credit check could not be loaded
credit.denied: You cannot see this order's credit check.
credit.waits: The amount over the limit waits for the server (CR-046). Confirming still checks the credit, and the server's answer is shown here.
credit.refused: The server refused to confirm this order
credit.refusedNext: Take a payment first, or ask for a credit override: an Owner or Manager other than you approves it.

outcome.PASSES: {{customer}} is within the credit limit and the terms with this order.
outcome.OVER_LIMIT: This order would take {{customer}} {{over}} over their {{limit}} credit limit.
outcome.PAST_TERMS: {{customer}} has {{overdue}} overdue, the oldest {{days}} days past due on {{terms}}-day terms.
outcome.ON_HOLD: {{customer}}'s account is on hold: no credit order is confirmed until it is released.
outcome.NOT_REQUIRED: Not a credit order: no credit check is needed.

override.title: Ask for a credit override on order {{order}}?
override.body: Say why the farm should give this credit. An Owner or Manager who is not you decides.
override.sent: The override waits for an Owner or Manager other than you
override.waiting: The override waits for an Owner or Manager other than {{who}}
override.EXPIRED: The override request lapsed without a decision

overrides.title: Credit overrides
overrides.empty: No credit override was ever approved for this buyer
overrides.error: The credit overrides could not be loaded
overrides.table: Each credit override, with who approved it

accounts.title: Wholesale accounts
accounts.emptyBody: Open an account to sell to a bakery, kitchen, chop bar or shop on credit.
accounts.error: The accounts could not be loaded

account.notFound: This customer has no wholesale account
account.notFoundBody: Open one from Wholesale accounts to sell to them on credit.
account.error: The account could not be loaded
account.onHold: On hold since {{when}}: no credit order is confirmed
account.noCreditLeft: No credit left: the next credit order needs a payment or an override
account.noPriceList: None of their own: channel prices
account.exposureHint: Owed now is unpaid invoices plus confirmed orders not yet invoiced, as the server works it out.
account.limitApproval: A limit raised past the farm's set amount waits for approval by someone other than you.
account.holdBody: No credit order is confirmed for them until the account is released. Say why.
account.releaseBody: Credit orders are checked against their limit and terms again. Say why.

outcome.limitWaiting: The new limit waits for approval by someone other than you

ageing.title: Ageing
ageing.emptyBody: Unpaid invoices of credit buyers appear here by how late they are.
ageing.error: The ageing could not be loaded
ageing.asOf: As the server worked it out on {{day}}
